name: nuwa
description: Nuwa distills anyone's way of thinking into a runnable perspective using a four-phase pipeline — multi-track research, triple-verified extraction, skill construction, quality validation.

displayDescription.zh: 女娲蒸馏知名人物的思维方式为可运行视角。给定名字（如乔布斯、芒格、纳瓦尔、马斯克），运行多路调研→三重验证提炼→技能构建→质量验证四阶段流水线，用其认知框架分析你的问题
displayDescription.en: Nuwa distills anyone's way of thinking into a runnable perspective. Give a public figure's name, and Nuwa runs a four-phase pipeline to produce a reusable perspective that analyzes problems using that person's cognitive framework
